title: Badminton Mobile Game by Opus5.5
author: SoftFine859
selftext: its just insane to me how a model, can perceive 3d movements in our real life, how the elbow and joints work together to swing the racket, how footwork in badminton works, and PORTRAIT IT BACK to 2d top down view, living in this era just feels amazing

comments.author: OinkLikeAPig
comments.body:
Its great!  
Few inputs:

\- Add multiplayer (as several already said)  
\- Make the power shot charge, so if you have a long time to hit it, it becomes better but also more risky  
\- Make it a bit faster

replies.author: UndeniablyRuthless
replies.body: I was able to do this. Got 2 v 2 in there as well

replies.author: SoftFine859
replies.body: its slow because the stamina bar of both characters are low, its much faster initially loll, for multiplayer, reference to my other replies, also, it will be much helpful if you can elaborate on the power shot, like holding the button to hit stronger? This approach perhaps make the game not user friendly tho

replies.author: OinkLikeAPig
replies.body:
It depends on your approach on the game of course. More power could result in more stamina deficit, but also make the player doing the power shot to have a good chance of getting the point filling up the power bar.   
It was just a quick thought scrolling on this sub.
